methods.terminal-large: Within-video action ranking,5-step deterministic endpoint, coefficient0.001.

protocol.basis: First two screens gave no robust planning winner. Renderer-to-encoder grounding is essential. Test action-ranking energy using the actual prior and Euclidean goal metric, without an auxiliary head.
protocol.scope: Existing mature models, short adaptation only. All candidates remain sample-level, no cross-sample statistics, EMA or additional parameters. All targets and prior inputs remain attached; preserve RGB grounding gradients. Original flow/rate plus a declared contrastive surrogate.
protocol.gate: Stop all20training at600extra updates; review finite weights, posterior/interventions, paired P0 before any continuation. Action alternatives are reversed/shifted within the same window, not simulator-confirmed wrong outcomes; false negatives are possible.

references.title: TWISTER: action-conditioned CPC
references.scope: Known contrastive predictive world-model research; our experiment uses no cross-sample negatives.

limitations: 600update adaptation from an existing2epochcheckpoint; not from-scratch training or a stability result.
Four existing mature training seeds; final claims need independent from-scratch training and unused evaluation cases.
P0twoevalseeds,16CFcases and64generationclips are a screen, not the full original benchmark.
Bootstrap intervals condition on these fixed weights and episode clusters; not uncertainty across training seeds.
Candidate/control comparisons are exploratory with no multiple-testing correction; selected wins require independent confirmation.
Forward values match the original rate/FM; semiaction ranking is not full-gradient original KL optimization.
Same parameter/update count is not equal compute; report per-arm training time and extra model calls.
Future states only enter training targets within the same video; no futureRGB is passed to inference.
